$comment: Asset ids referenced by salvaged production code, attributed to the systems whose files reference them, and grouped by the kind of game those systems make. Every one resolved against Roblox: they exist, and `kind`/`name` are the web API's own answer. Existing is not the same as loading -- delivery of non-public assets is authorised against the requesting universe, so an id here can still fail to render in a place that does not own it. It says which forty to look at, not which are good.

0.error: MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo() 0 is not a valid assetId

verified.$comment: Resolved with MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo, which asks the web API. It proves the asset exists and gives its real type and name. It does NOT prove the asset will load in your place: delivery of non-public assets is authorised against the requesting universe, so an id that resolves here can still fail to render in a place that does not own it.
